parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide a mechanism for Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for Data Principals to exercise their rights.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to provide means for Data Principals to exercise their rights.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may inquire into the fulfillment of conditions set out in Part A of First Schedule before deciding on an application.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a process for the Board to inquire into fulfillment of conditions.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the process for the Board to evaluate applications.

parsed_entries.requirement: The reference to any subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit provided or issued using public funds shall be construed as a reference to provision or issuance of such subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit by incurring expenditure on the same from, or with accrual of receipts to, public funds.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a definition for references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement defines the scope of references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.

parsed_entries.requirement: The term 'computer resource' shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Information Technology Act, 2000.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a definition for 'computer resource' aligned with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement defines 'computer resource' in alignment with the Information Technology Act, 2000.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Fiduciary must implement and disclose measures to mitigate risk.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for the Data Fiduciary to implement and disclose risk mitigation measures.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the obligation to implement and disclose risk mitigation measures.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide business contact information of a person who can respond to queries from Data Principals.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for the Data Fiduciary to provide contact information for responding to queries.
parsed_entries.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the obligation to provide contact information for responding to queries from Data Principals.

entry.requirement: The Board may reject an application and communicate the reasons for rejection to the applicant.
entry.checkable_test: Existence of a process for the Board to reject applications and communicate reasons.
entry.applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
entry.notes: This requirement outlines the process for the Board to reject applications and communicate reasons.
